safe_campus: A safer campus starts with a timely response.
report_intro: You can report without signing in. If you submit anonymously, save the reference number and access code so you can check the status later.
track_intro: Use the reference number and access code issued when the report was submitted.
emergency_intro: This notifies the security response team. If you allow location access, your coordinates are attached automatically.
offline_note: Offline mode stores only app files. Reporting and alerts need an internet connection.
